diagnostics.root_cause: The causal Transformer relies on standard generative softmax emissions. Because held-out operands (e.g. 300, 403, 506) and novel text strings were never seen in training targets, standard next-token prediction hallucinates high-frequency training constants (e.g. 13+3, 43+3) rather than executing an exact token copy.
diagnostics.pointer_mechanism_verdict: A dedicated pointer-generator attention head or token copying layer over prompt representations is mathematically necessary to achieve >0% exact argument copy on disjoint held-out operands.
